text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I don't want anything tying me down!
Total
freedom—that's my dream!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm running my way here at the spring Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's time to kick off! I'm the best, and I'm
feelin'
the best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's. Freakin'. Party! Waheeey!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Catch you guys after!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's right! ☆ You got this, queen!
Ignore the
pressure, do your thing, and
leave no crumbs! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer shakes her shoulders as if
shrugging
something off, pumps herself
up, and heads down
the runners' tunnel.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(The Tenno Sho... Winning this race has
always
been one of the big goals for all
Mejiro
Umamusume...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(And now... it's finally my turn! I'm on
equal
footing with them today!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is that... Hey, McQueen! Hey, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This is the race I've had my heart on
from the
beginning—the promised land.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I will be racing to the best of my ability
and
bringing home victory for the Mejiro
estate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I know this is a super important race for
you,
McQueen. I get that. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm a Mejiro too! I'm not just gonna let
you win!
I'm gonna keep moving forward
until I'm right
where I wanna be!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My name is Mejiro McQueen, and I hope

everyone enjoys the race today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm Mejiro Ryan. Thank you all for
coming!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere is so... different. It's like
a whole
different league—like a
different sport. I guess
that's the Tenno
Sho for you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(And I'm supposed to party in the
middle of all
this? After everyone just
made all these super
stiff introductions?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(But that doesn't matter! I'm free! I've
gotta
remember I'm free!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I can do whatever I want! I can go all
the way off
the rails if I want! And that's
just what I'm gonna
do!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Meji... Meji... Mejirooo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yesss, Palmster! ☆ Go off!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone has something important to
them
riding on this race. Especially
McQueen...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Compared to her, my determination,
dream, and
pride... They're practically
nothing...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Meji...ro... Palmer... in the h...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahem. I'm Mejiro Palmer. Let's have a
good race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: What happened to Palmster?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She falters in her big introduction. The
racecourse
is still buzzing, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The formality of the event is apparently
too much
for one girl's self-confidence.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She might not be able to act the way she
wants in
the paddock, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All bets are off when it comes to the
actual race.
All we can do is pray that
Mejiro Palmer can run
the way she wants
to.
